purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Local land office and cadastral map service directory found. Anonymous feature schema and point query were not completed. The public JUPEM ArcGIS directory advertises cadastral lot layers, but direct HTTPS metadata access failed TLS verification because the server certificate had expired. No TLS bypass was used. The separate TuahGIS parcel-map landing page timed out and its coverage relative to the WUP point is unverified.
registryAssessment: The official Melaka Tengah District and Land Office is the local land-administration office serving the city’s central district. Official Melaka GIS directory metadata exposes JUPEM cadastral lot layers (2021, 2016, 2013 and 2012), but the layer metadata/query was not fetched because the endpoint presented an expired TLS certificate. The point’s source-layer coverage and geometry remain unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Melaka Tengah District and Land Office page; local land administration.
Official Melaka government GIS MapServer directory lists JUPEM cadastral lot layers (Lot_Kadaster_2021, 2016, 2013 and 2012).
Official Hang Tuah Jaya TuahGIS lists a “Maklumat Lot Tanah” map, but its municipal footprint was not matched to this WUP locator.
